blocks.content: Quiz: You want a navigation menu to open and close each time the user clicks the menu button.
Tap an option below to answer:
Use classList.add('is-open') inside the click handler every time.
Adding the class every time would keep the menu open and never hide it. You need to switch between two states, not only add.
Adding the class every time would keep the menu open and never hide it. You need to switch between two states, not only add.
Use classList.remove('is-open') inside the click handler every time.
Removing the class every time would keep the menu closed. It doesn't alternate between states.
Removing the class every time would keep the menu closed. It doesn't alternate between states.
Use classList.toggle('is-open') inside the click handler.
toggle adds the class if it's missing and removes it if present. One click opens, the next closes.
toggle adds the class if it's missing and removes it if present. One click opens, the next closes.
You could use inline styles, but toggling a class is cleaner: CSS handles the look, JS only toggles the class.
